SELECT r.id AS id, r.reorder_type AS state, u.user_name AS userName, cc.class_name AS className, uc.unit_name AS unitName, r.count AS cnt, r.confirmed AS confirmed, r.center_code AS centerCode, CONVERT(VARCHAR (16), r.created_at, 120) AS createdAt FROM erp_reorder r JOIN erp_class_code cc ON CASE WHEN r.class_key LIKE 'N%' THEN SUBSTRING(r.class_key, 2, LEN(r.class_key)) ELSE r.class_key END = cc.class_key JOIN erp_unit_code uc ON r.unit_key = uc.unit_key JOIN erp_user u ON r.user_code = u.user_code WHERE r.yy = #{year} AND r.mm = #{month} AND (#{centerCode} = 'all' OR r.center_code = #{centerCode})
AND r.confirmed = 'unchecked'
